text:
nate: heads-up — seeing one of the app-of-apps syncs stall on prune, looks like a cascade timeout hitting the gpu-nodepool child apps
devops-bot: [ALERT] argocd/app-of-apps-master: sync failed (prune timeout) at 2026-02-05T18:04:16Z
olivia: ugh, which child apps are affected?
samir: the gpu nodepool apps (gpu-pool-us-west, gpu-pool-eu) plus a couple infra rolebindings that depend on them
ajay: exact error in argocd logs: `context deadline exceeded while waiting for resources to be pruned` — seems prune wave is trying to delete old DaemonSets/DaemonSet+CRs on nodes that are tainted for gpu:NoSchedule
nate: that matches — cluster autoscaler kicked in and drained nodes, but taints blocked pod eviction so prune hung waiting for finalizers
olivia: are we seeing high API server QPS or other rate limits? could be contributing to timeouts
samir: api-server looked fine, but there were a bunch of parallel prune operations from the app-of-apps children. ArgoCD does concurrent pruning by default which can blow up control-plane and kubelet edges when many GPU nodes are involved
ajay: short-term mitigation: disable pruning for the gpu pool apps and rerun sync. we can add `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: "SkipDryRun=true,Prune=false"` on those children in git
nate: I pushed a quick patch to the argocd-apps repo, PR: https://git.internal/rw/argocd-apps/pull/482 — adds sync-options + sync-wave for ordering. will link after CI passes
olivia: good. long-term we should: 1) add sync-wave annotations to ensure infra resources (nodepools, taint controllers) reconcile before tenant apps prune; 2) set pruning concurrency limits; 3) add an integrated pre-sync job that unlatches finalizers for GPU cleanup if needed
samir: also worth adding a guard in the GitOps pipeline: terraform-managed nodepools should have `prevent-prune: true` annotation until drain completes. prevents accidental deletes during rolling updates
ajay: agree, and we should also evaluate argocd-controller resource requests — it may need higher burst QPS for large fleets so it doesn't timeout on pruning operations
nate: temporary action items: olivia will flip prune=false on gpu-pool apps (done in PR 482), samir will add a k8s Job to clear stale finalizers if present, ajay will open an infra ticket to raise argocd-controller QPS and set concurrency limits
olivia: started the PR and triggered a manual sync on the app-of-apps. monitoring logs now. :eyes:
devops-bot: [DEPLOY] PR 482 merged by olivia at 2026-02-05T18:20:03Z (deploy-hook triggered)
samir: sync completed for app-of-apps, prune step skipped for gpu children, no more timeouts in the tail logs
ajay: cost note — while this was happening we briefly kept extra GPU nodes alive (draining failed) which added ~6 GPU-hours across clusters, approx $720 extra spend. we should add a postmortem line item for cost guardrails
nate: agree — I'll create a short incident note and attach the log snippets + PRs. moving to follow-up board: INFRA-873
olivia: leaving a TODO to add tests in our GitOps CI that simulate tainted nodes during prune waves so this doesn't regrow
ate: thanks everyone, close the loop if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
